name: @driftbox/rack
description: A modular synth rack: modules, cables between any of them, one graph at sample rate in a single AudioWorklet.
author: Louis Emmett
//version: 0.1.0 rather than 1.0.0, deliberately. The capability ledgers are complete — every row of docs/REBIRTH-PARITY.md and every ordered item in docs/REASON-GAP.md has landed — and the API is tiered and pinned by api.test.ts, so this is supportable. What is not settled is whether audio enters the document: REASON-GAP.md records that as the one architectural gap left, and the Looper and the Multisampler have each deferred it in opposite directions. That decision could still want a new shape in `Patch` rather than another optional field, and 0.x is the honest way to say so. It goes to 1.0.0 when that question is answered.
//publishConfig: A scoped package defaults to private, and a publish without this fails with a payment-required error that reads like a billing problem rather than a missing option. Same setting as the engine and the app.
//dependencies: Narrowly, for shared DSP and the additive groovebox document bridge. The ladder module wraps the engine's `Ladder` rather than copying it, while `groovebox.ts` uses the engine-owned Song codec rather than forking its schema. The engine is sideEffects:false, so consumers that only need the rack graph still drop the sequencer and songs.
//devDependencies: rolldown is here for one test. `minified.test.ts` bundles this package the way a consumer would and evaluates the worklet assembled from what came out, because the failure that scheme has is silent and happens only in somebody else's build. It is the bundler Vite already uses, so the test measures the pipeline the app really ships through rather than a stand-in.
